tool.name: cleanExportTool

param.name: Source_Metadata
param.dialogReference: This should be the full path to a standalone XML metadata document or a dataset with an existing metadata document.

param.name: Output_Dir
param.dialogReference: This should be the desired output directory - a unique filename will be generated.

param.name: FilePrefix
param.dialogReference: The exported filename(s) will have a fixed prefix. You may accept the default or provide your own.

tool.summary: Most Esri metadata tools perform some sort of transformation on a metadata record when exporting to a standalone XML document. This tool allows a metadata record to be exported as-is with no transformations.

dataIdInfo.idAbs: Most Esri metadata tools perform some sort of transformation on a metadata record when exporting to a standalone XML document. This tool allows a metadata record to be exported as-is with no transformations.
